meta.artefact: The FSM-succession overlay (composition-register factor 9) — the declared rule model and its single parameter
meta.supersedes: Factor 8 (data/ogasp/movement/alignment_rules.json) as the alignment instrument. Factor 8 is not deleted — its sweep is on record and its result stands as the measured negative that motivated this shape.
meta.scores_no_axis: This factor scores no axis of the APT criterion and must never be reported as incentive rationality (axis 6, closed), as adaptivity to the defender (axis 4 — this responds to the substrate), or as a fidelity improvement (at the limiting end it makes the attacker behave more like the host simulator expects, which is the opposite of behavioural independence). It is a declared COMPARABILITY CONCESSION and an instrument whose sweep measures a confound.
meta.boundary: Any claim about this factor's MTD response is confined to the position-destroying defence family. The 2 080-run factor-8 sweep measured the diversity family as producing hosts, distinct places and verb share identical to the no-MTD arm to three significant figures while interrupting 67 times per run, so the declared capability vocabulary is demonstrably blind to what OS and Service Diversity destroy.
meta.cti_independence: The authored artefact is the succession RULE and one dial; the CTI corpus supplies the prior (the base transition proportions) and alpha = 0 recovers it bit for bit. The relation itself is a transcription of the host simulator's own procedure, not a declared magnitude.

relation.form: targets = the verbs the inherited FSM licenses next, given the verb just run and the verdict it returned; or, if that action was interrupted, given the mutating resource's layer
relation.rationale: The inherited FSM already encodes a progress structure — after a compromise it runs SCAN_NEIGHBOR and then ENUM_HOST, so it pivots to a fresh host. Conditioning on that succession inherits the structure instead of re-deriving a worse one, which is precisely what factor 8's capability-distance target failed to do.
relation.successors_are_sets: Every successor is a set. The movement layer's verdict adapter treats ENUM_HOST, SCAN_PORT and SCAN_NEIGHBOR as success-unless-interrupted, so for two of them the substrate's branch is not recoverable from the verdict this modulator sees; both successors are declared rather than the modal one being guessed. That widens the permitted set and so cannot manufacture an alignment the FSM does not license.

dwell_transparency.form: a destination whose tactic dispatches no verb is never attenuated, and a visit to such a place does not advance the FSM state
dwell_transparency.rationale: A dwell-only place fires nothing, so it cannot violate the succession. Treating such places as free passage is what lets the attacker traverse its own CTI structure between FSM-legal actions rather than being forced onto the bare verb chain, and it is the difference between a dial that biases the attacker and one that replaces it. Under v2_partial seven of fifteen tactics are dwell-only, so the transparent structure is substantial.

capability_fallback.form: if no licensed successor can run in the attacker's current capability state, the targets become the first-step verbs on a shortest route to making one runnable
capability_fallback.rationale: Without it the dial drives the token at a dispatch the substrate refuses, which is the failure factor 8's sweep measured at its limiting end (blocked fraction 0.93 under the position-destroying family). This is the declared seam between the two controller relations: the succession says WHAT comes next, the closure says what must happen FIRST when it cannot.

routing.form: m(a->b) = 1.0 if b dispatches no verb or b's verb is a target, else (1 - alpha); composed multiplicatively and renormalised
routing.null: alpha = 0 makes the modulator return no factors at all, so the arithmetic is the pre-existing composition and the run is bit-identical to one with no state attached

off_band.rationale: PLACEHOLDER UNTIL THE CHECK RUNS. Unlike factor 8's argmin rule, this factor's permitted set is absolute rather than relative to the out-set, so no structural guarantee of a survivor exists and the floor cannot be argued — it must be measured by the exhaustive check.
off_band.check: src/mtdsim/l3_simulation/movement/succession.py succession_stall_report(), quantifying over every non-empty subset of the verb vocabulary, pinned by tests/l3_simulation/test_movement_succession.py

alpha.rationale: The declared value is the null, and the parameter is a continuous float over [0, 1] rather than a switch. This is a comparability concession, not a capability: alpha states how much of the inherited FSM's procedural rigidity the evaluation buys off so that two differently-shaped attackers can be compared on the same substrate. No operating point is a claim about any adversary, which is why the declared value is the arm that claims nothing.
alpha.band_argument: The endpoints are the two named positions: alpha = 0 is pure CTI-derived order and is the null arm that must reproduce every recorded figure at full strength; alpha = 1 permits only the inherited FSM's licensed next actions plus the attacker's own dwell-only structure. The interior points exist because the instrument's output is a dose-response curve and a curve needs interior points to be one. Intermediate values are the intended operating region for a comparability concession, which is the respect in which this parameter differs from factor 8's.
alpha.not_reported_as: alpha is swept, and any reported arm names its own alpha and quotes its own plurality figure. The S6 constraint binds: a badge may never be moved by choosing alpha. Note the distinction that keeps this legitimate — declaring a concession so two attackers are comparable is a stated methodological choice, whereas tuning alpha until a row improves is scoring-driven design and is forbidden.
alpha.scrutiny: Authored 2026-08-03 with the rule model. Has survived no adversarial review round; the sweep is the whole of its defence, and the pre-registration is the guardrail that the conclusions were fixed before any output existed.

tiers.corpus-grounded: derived from CTI / corpus data — deliberately empty here, as for every declared layer that conditions the corpus-grounded weights
tiers.attested-pattern/declared-magnitude: the behaviour is documented in the literature; the exact magnitude is declared. Deliberately empty: no literature attests a rate at which an attacker conforms to a simulator's procedural order, because the quantity is an artefact of this evaluation rather than a property of any adversary.
tiers.declared-judgement: reasoned from first-principles logic; not attested. The honest floor tier.

review_history: R0 2026-08-03 — authored with the rule model, after factor 8's sweep measured its target to be the wrong one
ledger_meta.reproducibility: There is no compiled value table to reproduce: the succession relation is a transcription and the dial declares nothing per cell. What stands in its place is the cross-examination of the relation against three independent sources (the substrate code, Brown Fig 3, Zhang Fig 7), pinned by test, plus the exhaustive no-stall check.

token_hold.ruling: supervisor_decision_register.md T1 (Jin, 2026-08-25): when the net's draw lands on a move the inherited FSM does not allow from the current state, leave the token where it is.
token_hold.reading: OPAQUE hold — dwell-only destinations are held out too. The transparent reading is rejection sampling from factor 9's alpha = 1 conditional and was measured DEGENERATE (fsm_succession_prereg.md B2-B3, section 4); it is not re-run under this name.
token_hold.scores_no_axis: Inherits factor 9's exclusion verbatim: not learning, not adaptivity to the defender, not a fidelity improvement. A supervisor-directed band point with its own pre-registration, not a third alignment factor (factor 9's stopping rule).
rules_kept_from_factor_9: abstention (no licensed destination -> the rule does nothing; a stall stays structurally impossible)
capability fallback (an unrunnable licensed successor is replaced by the first-step verbs that make it runnable)

max_consecutive_holds.rationale: The bound on consecutive holds at one routing decision; past it the plain draw is accepted and counted as a fall-through. Holds are geometric in the licensed mass p of the composed out-distribution, so the fall-through probability at a decision is (1 - p)^20: 1.2 % at p = 0.2, 12 % at p = 0.1, 36 % at p = 0.05. The value is chosen so that a decision with ordinary licensed mass essentially never falls through while a decision with vanishing licensed mass cannot consume the horizon holding. It is a backstop, not an operating point: the fall-through RATE is reported beside every result, and a material rate means the hold's result is partly the bound's.
max_consecutive_holds.not_reported_as: Never tuned to make the hold 'work' — factor 9's stopping rule binds (report what it does). Any reported hold arm quotes its fall-through rate.
max_consecutive_holds.scrutiny: Authored 2026-08-30 with the rule, before any hold run existed. Has survived no adversarial review round; the pre-registered run is the whole of its defence.
